MSCI new entrant OR displace threat index providers Solactive CRSP 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 列名指數對手：S&P Dow Jones Indices、FTSE Russell、Nasdaq、Bloomberg、Solactive；分析對手含 Axioma、BlackRock Solutions、Bloomberg、FactSet。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR MSCI 10-K FY2025 Item 1 Business
findings.excerpt: Among our Index competitors are S&P Dow Jones Indices LLC (a joint venture of S&P Global Inc. and CME Group Inc.); FTSE Russell, a subsidiary of the London Stock Exchange Group plc; Nasdaq Inc; Bloomberg Finance L.P. (“Bloomberg”); and Solactive AG.

findings.claim: 風險因子：對手與新進入者可能用 AI 以較低價格推出競爭產品，客戶也可能以 AI 自建客製指數、風險分析等取代 MSCI 產品；競爭可能造成降價或失去份額。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR MSCI 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: Competitors and new market entrants may use AI to develop products that compete with our offerings at lower price points, with faster time-to-market or with additional or better capabilities, which could impair our ability to compete effectively and put pressure on our revenues and subscriptions.

findings.claim: 最大客戶之一 BlackRock 同時是競爭者／分銷商，可能終止部分或全部關係。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR MSCI 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: Certain of our clients are also significant shareholders, competitors or distributors of our content, including some of our largest clients, such as BlackRock.

competitive_share_entrants.note: 兩次搜尋未找到具名份額消長數據或 Solactive／CRSP 搶單的第三方來源；僅有一手 10-K 風險描述。未下第 3、4 次搜尋。
